cards.notes: Shop ladder rung 1, deliver (user, 2026-11-22; README "Ladder"): no order, no cooking and no siren (`order_needed`, `cooking_needed` and `siren` false), food slips at the default chance. Serve every client with food from the pantry and pick fallen food up on the very next move. Fetching the food only makes `holding_food` true, so it gets no clause (the whenever-chain rule of the generator prompt), as in `shop-serve`. No clause starts at `holding_food`, so an agent that ends an episode holding a spare portion keeps every rule (the 2026-11-16 ladder's `Response(holding_food, order_served)` failed such agents, H14). `train` is false: the card is not in the counted 60-card set; the ladder's own runs file trains it.
